phases.name: Prep / Pain-management
phases.focus: Restore pain-free movement, build scapular control and rotator cuff endurance without overhead loading.

phases.name: Strength Foundation
phases.focus: Increase horizontal and pulling strength, progressive loading within pain-free range, emphasize scapular stability.

phases.name: Load Progression & Capacity
phases.focus: Increase force production and muscular endurance for climbing-related upper-body demands while maintaining shoulder safety.

non_negotiables: Follow physio guidance for ROM and exercise progressions
Stop and regress any exercise that produces sharp or increasing shoulder pain

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week Upper Body Strength for Climbers (Shoulder-safe, No Overhead Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary performance:
    name "Increase horizontal pushing and pulling strength, scapular control, rotator cuff endurance, and climbing-specific upper-body capacity while avoiding overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Prep / Pain-management" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Horizontal_Push_Scapular training 45m "Day 1 - Horizontal Push & Scapular Control":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pec_deck 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 4x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Pull_Emphasis_Rotator training 50m "Day 2 - Pull & Rotator Cuff":
        warmup:
          band_pull_aparts 5m
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
      DAY Active_Recovery_Mobility_Core training 40m "Day 3 - Active Recovery & Core":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x1m rpe 2 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Mixed_Upper_Grip training 55m "Day 4 - Mixed Upper Strength (no overhead) & Grip":
        warmup:
          wrist_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shrug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          farmers_walk 3x40m rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Horizontal_Push_Scapular training 50m "Day 1 - Horizontal Push & Scapular Control":
